name: resolve-mcp
description: Let Claude control DaVinci Resolve 21.0.4 Free: edit, color grade with power windows, render, verify every change.
long_description: Talks to the ClaudeBridge script running inside DaVinci Resolve (Workspace > Scripts > ClaudeBridge) over a token-protected loopback socket. Requires the repository installed with install.ps1; this extension only points Claude at it. Local only: no cloud calls, no telemetry.

install_dir.title: resolve-mcp folder
install_dir.description: The cloned repository where you ran install.ps1 (it contains .venv and server/mcp_server.py).
